wins: Identified perimeter SSH service with nmap default scripts, confirming potential entry point for credential-based access.
Successfully retrieved web server banner and mapped out application versioning, enabling informed follow-up exploitation attempts.
Documented network layout and pivot opportunities in lab environment, providing clarity for subsequent lateral movement planning.
fails: Unable to escalate privileges after initial shell access due to missing sudo rights and no exploitable local binaries.
Excessive mentor calls (15) indicate gaps in autonomous decision-making, slowing down the recon-to-exploit handoff.
Authentication attempts against SSH service consistently failed because of absent valid credential list.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance produced useful situational awareness, but exploitation stalled before achieving persistence; follow-up experiments should focus on credential gathering and privilege escalation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stop at low-privileged shell due to lack of sudo permissions or exploitable binaries.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with banner and error pages
skill_cards.then_action: Capture version info using curl followed by nikto/vuln scans

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial host is contacted and additional internal IP ranges are visible
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap ping sweep & traceroute to enumerate reachable subnets

memory_ops.reason: Reliable SSH enumeration led to confirmed service state in multiple steps.
Consistent version data enabled vulnerability focus and future exploit planning.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting via web form
next_experiments.description: Track down default credentials or Token leaks from discovered web app pages; automate form submissions and inspect hidden fields to collect valid SSH login pairs.

next_experiments.title: Local privilege escalation enumeration
next_experiments.description: After obtaining low-priv shell, run linPEAS and check sudoers with explicit enumeration to discover misconfigurations or scheduled tasks.

next_experiments.title: Pivot to adjacent subnet
next_experiments.description: From initial foothold, launch targeted scans on neighboring IP ranges discovered in traceroute to widen attack surface.
